description_for_human: Hub de educacao sanitaria: cursos, materiais e comunidade para empreendedores do setor regulado operarem com seguranca e sem penalizacoes da Vigilancia Sanitaria. Por Ester Caiafa.
description_for_model: Institutional site for TreinaVISA (Grupo TreinaVISA), a Brazilian sanitary-education hub founded by Ester Caiafa (sanitary nurse). Offers online courses, free implementation kits/checklists, a blog, and a free Telegram community for business owners in the Health, Aesthetics, Food and long-term-care (ILPI) sectors. Positioned as a school that teaches compliance autonomy (not a done-for-you consultancy), taught by people with real sanitary-inspection experience. Flagship course: 'Gabaritando a Fiscalizacao em Estetica' (R$ 97). Language: Brazilian Portuguese.
